fact: The ASIN director-general said in February 2025 that the agency had developed a conversational assistant with Google for its platforms, would add AI to the armed forces' personnel system that year, and would build AI foundations for the land agency, tax service, customs and ministries.
title: Marc-André Loko, directeur général de l'Asin : « Nous contribuons à révéler le Bénin dans le secteur du numérique »
